summary: A Markham firm covering real estate, wills and corporate work has the right services, but a broken phone link and duplicate pages appear to cost you calls.

findings.problem: The phone link appears to be written as tel:(905) 948-9200 with brackets and spaces, which may not dial on some phones.
findings.cost: Mobile visitors tapping to call may get nothing.
findings.fix: A clean tel link on every phone number.

findings.problem: The same buyer and seller services appear to exist at two different page addresses, and the logo link appears to have no https.
findings.cost: Duplicate pages confuse Google and visitors, and weaken search ranking.
findings.fix: One page per service with redirects.

findings.problem: Email now appears to link to the contact page, and no contact form appears on the homepage.
findings.cost: Visitors who want to write must work for it, so many leave.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form on the homepage and each service page.

findings.problem: No lawyer names, photos, testimonials or reviews appear, and the refinancing image appears to be labelled Debt Consolidation Markham.
findings.cost: Clients choosing a lawyer want to see who they will deal with.
findings.fix: Team profiles, reviews and correct image labels.

redesign: Team profiles, reviews and an enquiry form.
